title: Phlorizin, a novel caloric restriction mimetic, stimulates hypoxia and protects cardiomyocytes through activating autophagy via modulating the Hif-1alpha/Bnip3 axis in sepsis-induced myocardial dysfunction.
authors: Yu, Yong-Wei; Chen, Xia; Yan, Jue-Yue; Hu, Juan; Huang, Kai-Yu; Ji, Kang-Ting; Cai, Hong-Liu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究根皮苷通过Hif-1alpha/Bnip3轴调节自噬保护脓毒症心肌细胞，虽涉及分子对接但核心为细胞自噬与凋亡机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Sepsis is a systemic inflammatory syndrome that can lead to multiple organ dysfunction and life-threatening complications. Sepsis-induced myocardial dysfunction (SIMD) has been confirmed to be present in half of patients with septic shock, increasing their mortality rate to 70-90%. The pathogenesis of SIMD is complex, and no specific clinical treatment has yet been developed. Caloric restriction mimetics (CRM), compounds that simulate the biochemical and functional properties of CR, can improve cardiovascular injury by activating autophagy. This study investigated the effect of a new type of CRM which can induce hypoxia, the SGLT nonspecific inhibitor phlorizin on SIMD. MATERIALS AND METHODS: In vivo, phlorizin was administered at 1 mg/kg/day intragastrically for 28 days. In vitro, AC16 was treated with 120 muM phlorizin for 48 h. Echocardiography was used to assess cardiac function. Myocardial injury markers were detected in serum and cell supernatant. Western blotting was employed to detect changed proteins associated with apoptosis and autophagy. Immunofluorescence, immunohistochemistry, co-immunoprecipitation, molecular docking, and other methods were also used to illustrate cellular changes. RESULTS: In vivo, phlorizin significantly improved the survival rate and cardiac function after sepsis injury, reduced markers of myocardial injury, inhibited myocardial apoptosis and oxidative stress, and promoted autophagy. In vitro, phlorizin alleviated the apoptosis of AC16, as well as inhibited oxidative stress and apoptotic enzyme activity. Phlorizin acts on autophagy at multiple sites through low energy (activation of AMPK) and hypoxia (release of Beclin-1 by Hif-1alpha/Bnip3 axis), promoting the formation and degradation of autophagosomes. CONCLUSION: We indicated for the first time that phlorizin could inhibit glucose uptake via GLUT-1 and conforms to the metabolic characteristics of CRM, it can induce the hypoxic transcriptional paradigm. In addition, it inhibits apoptosis and improves SIMD by promoting autophagy generation and unobstructing autophagy flux. Moreover, it affects autophagy by releasing Beclin-1 through the Hif-1alpha/Bnip3 axis.
abstract_zh: 背景：脓毒症是一种全身性炎症综合征，可导致多器官功能障碍和危及生命的并发症。脓毒症诱导的心肌功能障碍（SIMD）已被证实存在于半数脓毒性休克患者中，使其死亡率升至70-90%。SIMD的发病机制复杂，目前尚无特异性临床治疗方法。热量限制模拟物（CRM）是一类模拟CR生化及功能特性的化合物，可通过激活自噬改善心血管损伤。本研究探讨了一种能诱导缺氧的新型CRM——SGLT非特异性抑制剂根皮苷对SIMD的作用。材料与方法：在体内实验中，根皮苷以1 mg/kg/天的剂量灌胃给药28天。在体外实验中，AC16细胞用120 μM根皮苷处理48小时。采用超声心动图评估心脏功能。检测血清和细胞上清液中的心肌损伤标志物。使用蛋白质印迹法检测与凋亡和自噬相关的蛋白变化。还采用免疫荧光、免疫组织化学、共免疫沉淀、分子对接等方法阐明细胞变化。结果：在体内，根皮苷显著提高了脓毒症损伤后的存活率和心脏功能，降低了心肌损伤标志物，抑制了心肌凋亡和氧化应激，并促进了自噬。在体外，根皮苷减轻了AC16细胞的凋亡，并抑制了氧化应激和凋亡酶活性。根皮苷通过低能量（激活AMPK）和缺氧（通过Hif-1α/Bnip3轴释放Beclin-1）在多部位作用于自噬，促进自噬体的形成和降解。结论：我们首次表明，根皮苷可通过GLUT-1抑制葡萄糖摄取，符合CRM的代谢特征，并能诱导缺氧转录范式。此外，它通过促进自噬生成和畅通自噬流来抑制凋亡并改善SIMD。而且，它通过Hif-1α/Bnip3轴释放Beclin-1来影响自噬。
